feeds.title: Translating Cuba English Translations of Cubans Writing From the Island
feeds.description: Translating Cuba is a window to an alternative information system about Cuba (the independent blogosphere), which continues to expand. Cuba's independent journalists and bloggers have become the real reporters of the island, and the voice of the Cuban people. The voices on this site will mirror the free, open and plural society we all know that Cuba is ultimately destined to be.

feeds.title: Havana Times
feeds.description: Havana Times is an independent source for news and opinion on and from Cuba. Get the voice of Cuban youth as well as reports from seasoned journalists.

feeds.title: Locally Sourced Cuba Tours Blog
feeds.description: Locally Sourced Cuba Tours is dedicated to providing you with an authentic and unforgettable tour experience in Cuba. They will use this forum to highlight some of our impressions, reflections and opinions on Cuba in the present day and its future. They will also use this forum to highlight any experiences, excursions, activities and events that we feel you should know about.

feeds.title: My Big Fat Cuban Family
feeds.description: All about my Cuban-American life. My name is Marta Darby and I'm a Cuban-American homeschooling, scrapbooking, creative-type mother of 4. Enjoy my ramblings on my blog about my Cuban family, Cuban heritage, Cuban culture, and Cuban life. And some decent Cuban recipes with pictures too.

feeds.title: Inter Press Service en Cuba
feeds.description: IPS-Cuba is a foreign press correspondent accredited in Havana that, with the support of a wide group of collaborators, intends to elaborate and provide alternative information on the island, with an analytical, diverse, plural and inclusive view.

feeds.title: La Joven Cuba Socialismo y Revolución
feeds.description: A blog of university students who think about the Cuban reality.

feeds.title: Revolución de Cuba Blog | Rum Bar and Cantina
feeds.description: Read about the latest goings on at Revolución de Cuba, master the most delicious cocktail recipes and bring a little Latin spirit to your life.

feeds.title: Cubaninsider
feeds.description: The sole publisher of Cubaninsider, Rich Haney, has passionately studied Cuba day and night since the 1980s and he has visited the island. He is a fiercely pro-democracy conservative Republican from Virginia and he believes the Cuban Revolution and Revolutionary Cuba say more about the United States than they say about Cuba.

feeds.title: Cuba US People to People Partnership
feeds.description: Know everything about Cuba.

feeds.title: The Complete Cuba Blog
feeds.description: Complete Cuba trip information as well as interesting newsworthy posts about Cuba, the Cuban economy, travel to Cuba, photography and the tsunami of change affecting US/Cuban relations. Cuba Travel. Complete Cuba provides legal travel opportunities through people-to-people trips to Cuba.

feeds.title: The New Cuba | Supporting all things New Cuba. Travel Experiences
feeds.description: The New Cuba offers consulting, curated trips, talent booking, VIP/Concierge service, and content creation on the island — all with the intention of fostering better understanding of the current culture and climate of the Cuban people. This blog is an inspiration board of all things New Cuba, as well as some of our current projects.

feeds.title: The Cuban Economy La Economía Cubana
feeds.description: This Blog on The Cuban Economy is dedicated to Cuba's Generation 'A'. Although inspired by Yoani Sánchez' blog 'Generation Y' this is not dedicated to those with names starting with the letter 'A'. The objective of this Blog is to facilitate access to research resources and analyses from all relevant and useful sources, mainly on the economy of Cuba.

feeds.title: Visit Cuba
feeds.description: Visit Cuba is your complete travel guide to Cuba at visitcuba.com. Discover Cuba's most beautiful cities and beaches or browse our restaurant guide by city or food type. We have all the information you need on cultural venues, nightlife, local events, activities and more! Discover the authentic, real Cuba with Visit Cuba.

feeds.title: Here is Havana | A blog written by the gringa next door
feeds.description: A blog written by the gringa next door, conspires to give you a dose of what life is really like across the Straits.

feeds.title: EXPERIENCE THE REAL CUBA
feeds.description: I want to share my Cuba and offer real life experiences living with a family in a casa particular, learning Spanish and getting to know the real Cuba. Learn Spanish, Salsa & take part in Music, Art or Pottery workshops in Cuba with Experience The Real Cuba - it's the best way of getting to know Cuba!

feeds.title: Cubano de Cuba
feeds.description: Culture and experience of Cubans around the World

feeds.title: Cuba Central The Blog
feeds.description: A weekly publication from the Center for Democracy in the Americas. The Center for Democracy in the Americas (CDA) is a non-partisan institution dedicated to promoting a U.S. policy toward Cuba based on engagement and recognition of Cuba's sovereignty.

feeds.title: Canada Cuba Blog | Bringing Culture & Sports Together
feeds.description: Since 1988 Canada Cuba been providing joint programs of exploration in the arts, sport, and education. Essentially what we do is bring people together who have a curiosity about each other. Read our blog to stay up to date with our latest news and stories!

feeds.description: Blog corporativo de los hoteles Meliá en CubaMeliá Cuba is the division in charge of the commercialization and administration of the hotels and resorts that Melia Hotels International manages in Cuba, which are distinguished by a strong presence and corporate image, being leaders, being located in the best destinations in the country and having the best of the human capital of the Island.

feeds.title: Espíritu Travel | Cuba Travel Blog
feeds.description: Cuba Travel Blog from the Espíritu Travel to Cuba experts and agents. Your guide to visit Cuba from US is on Cuba Travel Blog by Espíritu Travel. Legal and authentic people to people tours to Cuba. Our small group tours, no more than 6 people, have been created so that you discover the story of Cuba. Our goal is to offer travelers authentic trips in a way that makes a positive impact to local communities and the places that they visit.
